business_summary: Zhejiang Linuo Flow Control Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of industrial control valves in China and internationally. The company offers ball, segment ball, butterfly, gate, globe, check, regulating, fluoropolymer-lined, rubber-lined, power station, flat gate, and special-purpose valves, as well as positioners. It serves the petroleum and petrochemical, new energy, pharmaceutical, cryogenic equipment, aerospace, power, metallurgy, environmental protection, chemical, lithium battery, polysilicon, pulp and paper, and other industries. The company exports its products. The company exports its products. Zhejiang Linuo Flow Control Technology Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Ruian, China.
